abstract: The BRAIN Initiative Cell Atlas Network (BICAN) is establishing an evolving reference for neuroscience by integrating cell identities, anatomy, and multimodal evidence across species. In analogy with the Human Genome Project, the BICAN basal ganglia atlas is a model for a federated reference to advance understanding of brain organization, function, variation, and disease.
